growth_rate.caveat: Building-permit data is often published at county level, not per-suburb -- may render as a county-level proxy shown per suburb.
growth_rate.description: New housing units authorized per 1,000 existing homes (Building Permits Survey, county-level proxy)

commute_time_min.description: Mean travel time to work, minutes (ACS 5-year estimate) -- a commute-time proxy for traffic, not a congestion index

violent_crime_rate.description: Violent crime rate vs. national average

property_crime_rate.description: Property crime rate vs. national average

monthly_climate_table.description: 12-month table of average high/low temp, rainfall, snowfall. One citation for the whole table (e.g. NOAA climate normals), not per-cell. Display-only, not a score input.

school_list_ratings.caveat: School ratings are LLM-synthesized -- as fabrication-prone as any LLM-estimated number, rendered with the same visible caveat as a low-confidence field rather than presented with false authority.
school_list_ratings.description: List of schools serving this suburb with their ratings

school_locations.description: Named schools and straight-line distance, from OpenStreetMap POI data. Display context for school_list_ratings, not independently scored.

retail_target_distance_mi.description: Straight-line distance to nearest Target, miles

retail_costco_distance_mi.description: Straight-line distance to nearest Costco, miles

retail_wholefoods_distance_mi.description: Straight-line distance to nearest Whole Foods / Trader Joe's / Sprouts, miles

mountain_biking_distance_mi.caveat: OpenStreetMap trail tagging is inconsistent -- a large distance may mean no nearby trail, or an untagged one. Query returning zero results is recorded as confirmed_absent, not unresolved.
mountain_biking_distance_mi.description: Straight-line distance to nearest mapped mountain-bike trail, miles

pickleball_distance_mi.caveat: Same OSM tagging caveat as mountain_biking_distance_mi.
pickleball_distance_mi.description: Straight-line distance to nearest mapped pickleball court, miles

rec_center_distance_mi.description: Straight-line distance to nearest recreation center, miles

grid_reliability.caveat: No established public source at suburb granularity -- prototype against 2-3 real suburbs before finalizing; if fill rate is low, fall back to a county-level display value.
grid_reliability.description: Frequency of power outages/rolling blackouts/seasonal grid failures. Display-only, not a Family Fit score input.

water_source.description: Where municipal/regional water originates. Display-only, not a Family Fit score input.
